reports.title: SOLV ENERGY REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: Based on strong year to date execution and the Company’s current expectations for the remainder of the year, SOLV is raising its full-year 2026 financial outlook.
The Company’s updated full-year 2026 financial guidance for the year ending December 31, 2026 is as follows:

(in millions, unless noted otherwise) | Revised FY26 Guidance | Prior Guidance1
Revenue | $4,030 - $4,120 | $3,870 - $3,970
Adjusted Gross Profit2 | $660 - $690 | $620 - $660
Adjusted Gross Margin (%)2 | 16.4% - 16.7% | 16.0% - 16.6%
Adjusted EBITDA | $525 - $540 | $485 - $505
Adjusted EBITDA Margin (%) | 13.0% - 13.1% | 12.5% - 12.7%
1) | As previously presented on the Company’s second quarter 2026 earnings release on August 13, 2026
2) | Adjusted Gross Profit and Adjusted Gross Margin exclude the impact of the allocation of non-cash compensation expense to cost of revenue
